title: Moving services in Évora
meta_description: Prepare a move in Évora: cargo, access, parking, helpers, protection and additional services.
hero_description: A move in Évora must consider the specific conditions of collection and delivery. In Évora, the protected historic center, the pavement, conditioned access and the differences between urban neighborhoods and housing influence the service.
direct_answer_heading: What to confirm before moving to Évora
key_points_heading: Information needed to receive useful quotes
faq_heading: Questions about moving services in évora
direct_answer: Indicate the specific collection and delivery locations, the date, inventory, floors, lifts, stairs and where the vehicle can stop. Also inform the manual carrying distance, the necessary services and the items that require special protection. In Évora, the protected historic center, the pavement, conditioned access and the differences between urban neighborhoods and housing influence the service.
key_points: Identify specific collection and delivery locations.
Confirm where the vehicle can stop at both ends.
Describe floors, lifts, stairs, gates, and garages.
Send photographs of the largest items and difficult access.
Compare quotes based on the same load and the same tasks.

sections.heading: Areas and access conditions in Évora
paragraphs: The generic indication of “Évora” may not be enough. The specific area influences the vehicle's approach and manual route.
Indicate the location at both ends and separately describe the collection and delivery access points.

items.title: Historic center
items.text: Confirm restricted access, narrow streets, pavement, parking and manual route.

items.title: Horta das Figueiras
items.text: Indicate floors, lifts, garages and access conditions to buildings.

items.title: Malagueira
items.text: Describe the correct entrance, residential streets, parking and distance to the property.

items.title: Bacelo and Lady of Health
items.text: Confirm access to houses, gates, patios and space to maneuver the vehicle.

sections.heading: How to prepare inventory
paragraphs: Organize the load by rooms or categories and separate furniture, appliances, boxes and special items.
Indicate approximate measurements and send photographs when there are doubts about doors, stairs, lifts or protection.

items.title: Furniture
items.text: List sofas, beds, tables, cabinets, bookshelves and other large furniture.

items.title: Household Appliances
items.text: Identify refrigerators, machines, televisions and other equipment.

items.title: Boxes
items.text: Indicate an approximate quantity and highlight fragile or heavy boxes.

items.title: Special items
items.text: Mark fragile, valuable, heavy or difficult-to-move items.

sections.heading: Access, parking and route
paragraphs: In Évora, the protected historic center, the pavement, conditioned access and the differences between urban neighborhoods and housing influence the service.
When the vehicle cannot approach the entrance, indicate the distance, slope, steps and type of flooring.
checklist: Existence and approximate dimensions of lifts.
Stairs, doors, corridors and tight turns.
Possible place to stop the vehicle.
Distance between the vehicle and each entrance.
Allowed times for loading and unloading.

sections.heading: Services that must be defined
paragraphs: The quote must indicate the vehicle, the number of helpers, loading, unloading and protection of items.
Disassembly, assembly, packing, materials and additional equipment must be agreed in advance.

items.title: Helpers
items.text: Confirm how many people will participate in loading and unloading.

items.title: Disassembly and assembly
items.text: Identify the furniture covered and who will perform each task.

items.title: Packing and protection
items.text: Confirm the materials planned for furniture, appliances and fragile items.

items.title: Additional equipment
items.text: Inform about heavy parts or access that may require specific means.

sections.heading: How to compare quotes for change in Évora
paragraphs: Send the same description to all carriers, including locations, inventory, access and tasks.
Compare the price together with the vehicle, the team, the protection, the services included and the conditions presented.
checklist: The origin and destination are the same.
The access conditions to both locations were described.
The number of helpers is indicated.
The price and conditions are recorded in writing.

sections.heading: How to request quotes through CargoPT
paragraphs: At CargoPT, you can describe a move in Évora once, including the load, access and tasks.
Carriers submit their own quotes and the customer can compare responses based on the same description.

faq.question: What locations should I indicate?
faq.answer: Indicate the street or specific area of collection and delivery, not just the municipality or region.

faq.question: What details should I confirm about the properties?
faq.answer: Check floors, stairs, doors, corridors, lifts, gates, garages and distance to the vehicle.

faq.question: Does the distance to the vehicle influence the service?
faq.answer: Yes. A long, inclined route or with steps can increase the time and number of helpers needed.

faq.question: When should I send photos?
faq.answer: Send photographs of large furniture, special items and access points that are difficult to describe.

faq.question: How to compare different quotes?
faq.answer: Confirm that they all consider the same load, the same access, helpers, protection and additional services.
